reuse.why: Puts the new rule in shared/schedules.ts and routes getScheduledAmount through it, but the server sites call the new range-only helper inside their own missing/number dispatch instead of the existing getScheduledAmount that already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: All six midpoint copies are replaced by one getWorstCaseAmount, though the surrounding null/number/range ternary remains repeated at four sites.

placement.why: The amount rule lives in the shared schedules module next to getScheduledAmount, which both server and client already import.

scope.why: Only the midpoint expressions, their comments, a unit test and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Future changes to the ranged-amount rule are a one-line edit; the leftover per-site dispatch is minor friction.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every ranged-amount site, including getScheduledAmount used by the client, now goes through getWorstCaseAmount; the sites' dispatch predates the change.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated rule remains; the per-site dispatch is unchanged pre-existing code.

one_place.where: getWorstCaseAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), forecast-schedules.ts and schedule-template.ts.
